iaaft_null: amplitude-adjusted Fourier surrogates preserving the panel amplitude distribution and approximately preserving its power spectrum

stronger_airgun_control.score_exclusion_basis: The widest local-energy window is 4 s, so a score can include a raw-pressure sample up to 2 s from its centre; dilate the ±1 s pressure mask to ±3 s when displaying uncontaminated score samples.

interpretation: All tests use already-filtered, vector-extracted publication traces. The 00:47-00:50 window was selected after visual inspection, so its window p-value is exploratory. Source-time alignment is conditional on a point target and celerity; it is not an event association.
